title: SB 6002 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2; Title 4; Title 5; Title 6; Title 7; Title 8 and Title 55, relative to non-United States citizens.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 10, 2-7-112(c)(1) and (3)
(quote) (1) A Tennessee driver license that is not a temporary driver license; (3) A Tennessee photo identification license issued pursuant to § 55-50-336 that is not a temporary photo identification license;
(section) Sec. 14, 55-50-331(g)(1) (rewritten)
(quote) A temporary license or permit shall not be used and must not be accepted as valid identification where eligibility for a right or benefit is exclusive to United States citizens, including, but not limited to, voting.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 14, 55-50-331(g)(3)
(quote) A temporary driver license, temporary photo identification license, or temporary permit must include a visually distinctive marker for the class designation on the face of the license to distinguish the temporary license from the license issued to United States citizens under § 55-50-303(a)(9) that is used as a photo identification for voting purposes.
(section) Sec. 14, 55-50-331(g)(4)
(quote) A lawful permanent resident who renews or reinstates a driver license, permit, or photo identification license on or after January 1, 2026, must provide proof of United States citizenship to maintain the driver license, permit, or photo identification license. If such proof of citizenship is not provided, then the person must be issued a temporary driver license, temporary permit, or temporary photo identification license pursuant to this section.
(section) Sec. 12, 55-50-321(c)(1)(C)
(quote) Any applicant applying for a driver license, instruction permit, intermediate driver license, or photo identification license, upon initial issuance or reinstatement, shall provide either an original or certified copy of documentation that the applicant is a citizen of the United States.
(section) Sec. 11, 55-50-303(a)(9)
(quote) To any person who is not a United States citizen.
(other) Sec. 1: creates the centralized immigration enforcement division and chief immigration enforcement officer in the department of safety (expires 1/20/2029 unless reauthorized).
(other) Sec. 2: commissioner of safety to seek a 287(g) agreement with the U.S. attorney general.
(other) Secs. 3-4, 7-8: unlawful for an official to adopt a sanctuary policy (Class E felony); removal-from-office action on conviction; local governing-body votes count.
(other) Sec. 5: immigration enforcement grant program and fund for local 287(g) agreements. Sec. 6: law enforcement may negotiate 287(g) agreements without governing-body approval. Sec. 9: adds the CIEO to 7-68-105(c)(1).
(other) Sec. 13: 55-50-321(i)(1) proof of citizenship (or LPR status / authorised stay for temporary licence) for persons with licences from states that license illegal aliens.
(other) Sec. 15: 55-50-102(56) exception for LPRs. Sec. 16: severability. Sec. 17: effective dates (Secs. 10-15 on 1/1/2026).
(other) The filed Draft had a smaller 2-7-112 change (only (c)(1) limited to non-temporary licences); SA6001 widened it to (c)(3).
(other) version: 3072439-Draft (no House header): Sec. 9: 2-7-112(c)(1) adds 'that is not a temporary driver license'; Secs. 10-14 licence rules incl. 55-50-331(g)(1) sentence barring temporary licences as ID 'where eligibility ... is exclusive to United States citizens, including, but not limited to, voting', visual marker, LPR proof on renewal from 1/1/2026.
(other) version: 3074193-Draft (adds HB6001 Lamberth header): same operative text as 3072439 (no substantive change found).
(other) version: amend-223626-SA6001 (Senate Government Operations amendment 1; adopted by the Senate 1/29/2025 per action log; file flag 0): replaces Sec. 9 so 2-7-112(c)(1) AND (3) are limited to non-temporary licences; adds a new Sec. 6 (7-68-105(b)); adds 'effective no later than July 1, 2025' to the grant program; rewrites the effective-date section.
(other) version: amend-223979-SA6007 (Senate Finance, Ways and Means amendment; adopted 1/29/2025): adds confidentiality for division records and restates the grant program with the effective date; no ID text.
(other) version: amend-223980-SA6010 (tabled; no ID text; deletes Sec. 3 and changes effective dates), amend-223981-SA6011 (tabled; no ID text; bars immigration enforcement within 1,000 feet of schools and places of worship), amend-223982-SA6012 (failed 6-27; deletes Secs. 10-15, i.e. REMOVES the 2-7-112 and licence rules; carries no ID text of its own).
(other) version: 3239455-Chaptered (PC 1, First Extraordinary Session): Draft + SA6001 + SA6007, as Senate Bill 2. Slots a and e only.
(other) note: Extraordinary-session bill (called SB6002 here; SB2/HB1 in the chaptered text). It is an immigration-enforcement act; only Secs. 10-15 touch voting ID or citizenship markers, and they take effect 1/1/2026. The citizenship-proof and marker rules attach to driver licences and photo ID licences, not to registration; they are tied to voting by 2-7-112(c) and the 55-50-331(g) wording. The Transportation and Safety committee vote says 'with amendment/s' but no amendment of that committee is in the saved files; SA6002-SA6006 are not saved. House floor amendments (#3, #4, #6, #7, #8, #9, #10) are not saved, and HA6031/HA6032 (withdrawn) are not saved. The House passage vote was on the Senate-passed bill substituted for HB6001, so the voted text equals the chaptered text.
